lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  let U := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF
  change ((mulLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂ T) a b =
    (mulLinearMap.compr₂ U) a b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun xs =>
    ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun ys => ?_) a b
  dsimp only [T, U, c, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  rw [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, hs⟩ : ∃ l1 l2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp, ∀ l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp,
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ l ++ ys) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 :=
    ⟨_, _, fun l h =>
      (insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ xs l ys h).trans
        (List.append_assoc _ _ _)⟩
  rw [map_mul ι, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
  trans ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (xs ++ φ :: ψ :: ys) •
        (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2))
  ·
      congr 1
      simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
      simp only [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul,
        timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at hs ⊢
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
      erw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
      rfl
  ·
      rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
        (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      have hr : crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ ys) = l1 ++ l2 := by
        simpa only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append] using hs [] (by simp)
      rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← hr]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
          (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign, mul_smul_comm]
